'''Bas Bishop''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for the pharmaceutical company [[Culpharm]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Bishop had a high up position within Culpharm and was senior to [[Carlitina Semla]], the head of [[Culpharm Security]]. In about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], some of Culpharm's specimen samples went missing, so Semla hired some [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] to find them. Bishop hassled Semla to try and make progress in resolving the issue.
